products.quality: Emits only G1 line segments; staff confirm 'LB and MillMage do not use circular interpolation'. Imported G2/G3 are dropped on re-save. Long-standing feature request open; segmentation via Bezier splines, not exact arcs.

Staff-confirmed no G2/G3: Bezier splines segmented at ~0.60 mm chord length, not user-adjustable. Devs argue arc emission 'only gets you file compression' and reclamation isn't worth CPU cost on hobby controllers.

Vectorization emits stair-stepped G1 segments; no arc generation (issue #170, never closed by a release). Streams external G2/G3 files but preview has rendered arcs incorrectly (issue #1134). Dormant project, unlikely to change.
xTool Studio/XCS can export G-code (D-series, S1, M1, F2 Ultra articles), but no source documents whether output uses arcs or segments; internals of the closed pipeline unverified.

evidence.cite: No arc/segmentation documentation found across support.xtool.com search passes 2026-07-13

products.quality: Official G-code spec allows linear moves only — 'arcs must be linearized'; imports containing G2/G3 are rejected outright, and users report Easel-generated code is entirely G1.

Mature: S-Value Max must mirror GRBL $30 (docs explain mismatch failure modes); per-layer Constant Power toggle (M3) vs M4 variable power with zero-speed-zero-power; dedicated GRBL-M3 device for pre-1.1f firmware.

CNC framing: per-operation feeds/speeds including spindle RPM in the Operation Settings Editor; separate 'GRBL M3' device profile; GRBL firmware settings viewable/editable in-app. Laser power modes N/A (CNC-only product).
Import dialog offers M3 constant vs M4 dynamic power (grbl 1.1+ laser mode); S-MIN/S-MAX map white/black pixels onto the PWM range; docs tell users to match machine PWM config. Solid but manual.
Power is exposed only as percentage presets via the EasySet material library or manual %/speed fields; no user-facing M3/M4 selection or S-max/$30 mapping in the closed xTool ecosystem.

evidence.cite: No M3/M4/S-max controls documented anywhere in support.xtool.com; inferred absent from closed pipeline

products.quality: Automatic/manual spindle control adds M3/M5 with spindle RPM to G-code (shipped 2015); no laser-style scaling. Basic on/off + RPM, adequate for its grbl router audience.

Deep: GCode device-settings tab tweaks output; Custom GCode device type (since 1.5) can override every emitted command, with |RESTORE| mode macros and \x hex control-character escapes (2.1+). Expert-oriented but comprehensive.

Custom GCode tab: tool-change output and ATC toggles, coolant on/off hooks (M8/M9 guide), configurable comment characters, variable-substitution syntax with change-tracking ([x] = unchanged, * = skip-line-if-unchanged).
Custom header/between-passes/footer G-code since v3.0.19, sharing the custom-button macro language incl. realtime commands; a reported bug omitted header/footer from saved files (issue #1172).
No custom header/footer/hook capability documented anywhere in the xTool support center; likely absent in the closed app but not provably so.

evidence.cite: Absence across support.xtool.com article searches 2026-07-13 (articles 636/933/1303/2442 reviewed)
